digest.component_or_area: External integration test suite for Jira Cloud S3 reconciliation
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live test suite for Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation (REB and DIG projects) was removed when focus shifted to Data Center; this story restores coverage of S3 backend and real Cloud volume/diversity.
The test suite uses only proven non-mutating read paths (compute_snapshot for inbound fetch, bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode) against live Cloud projects over an isolated, throwaway S3 store.
Structural read-only enforcement is achieved via an autouse fixture that monkeypatches all mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, making the suite unable to invoke Jira mutations.
Per-project issue counts are asserted identical before and after each Jira-touching test scenario to enforce the no-write invariant (belt-and-braces validation).
The integration test suite covers multi-project fetch scoping, S3 round-trip persistence, fail-closed behavior for unmapped projects, and zero Jira mutations in preview mode.
